d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Director of Sales & Marketing to lead the pre-opening and launch of all sales, marketing, and business development initiatives at Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort.

This senior leadership role is responsible for building the brand presence, driving revenue growth, and establishing strong market positioning for both resorts from day one. You will play a key role in creating strategies that align with the luxury and lifestyle positioning of Tivoli and Avani, respectively.
r: Lead all pre-opening Sales & Marketing planning, including brand positioning, market analysis, promotional strategies, and go-to-market campaigns.
Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies to drive room, event, F&B, and leisure revenue across all business segments.
Build and manage a high-performing Sales & Marketing team, providing coaching, training, and performance management.
Establish and maintain relationships with corporate clients, travel partners, tour operators, and key stakeholders to drive bookings and partnerships.
Oversee digital marketing, PR, advertising, and social media strategies to generate awareness and demand ahead of opening.
Coordinate with Revenue Management, Operations, and F&B teams to align sales strategies with pricing, packages, and promotions.
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and guest feedback to continuously refine strategies and maintain a competitive edge.
Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, and performance reports for ownership and senior management.
Plan and execute pre-opening events, soft openings, and launch campaigns to maximize media coverage and brand exposure.
Ensure all sales and marketing initiatives adhere to brand standards and positioning of both Tivoli and Avani.

This role is ideal for a pre-opening Sales & Marketing leader with strong hospitality experience, commercial acumen, and a proven track record in driving brand awareness, market share, and revenue growth in a luxury or lifestyle resort environment.

d: If you’ve worn a pair of glasses, we’ve already met.

We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms.
Join our global community of over 190,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry.
Discover more by following us on LinkedIn!

r: The Logistics Manager is responsible for planning, directing, and controlling all logistics activities, including transportation, warehousing, import/export operations, customs clearance, and distribution within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and international markets. The role ensures compliance with group policies & Saudi regulations, operational efficiency, cost optimization, and products are delivered to customers safely, efficiently, on time, and within budget.
Develop and implement logistics strategies aligned with business objectives.
Manage inbound and outbound transportation activities across KSA and GCC markets.
Oversee warehouse and distribution center operations.
Ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of products to customers.
Monitor distribution center activities and coordinate with procurement, CIC, production, and business teams.
Optimize transportation routes and warehouse utilization.
Coordinate CAPA implementation resulting from audits, inspections, deviations, or customer complaints.
Ensure all logistics activities are conducted according to approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Manage company-owned fleet, including vehicle/Bike utilization, maintenance planning, registration, insurance, and licensing.
Ensure compliance with driver qualification, training, and road safety requirements.
Monitor fuel consumption, fleet productivity, and transportation costs.
Ensure compliance with TGA requirements related to fleet operations and driver management.
Develop and manage logistics operating budgets.
Monitor transportation, warehousing, customs, and distribution costs.
Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives while maintaining service levels.
Support annual budgeting and forecasting processes.
Ensure compliance group policies & Saudi customs regulations and import/export requirements in alignment with EMEA Trade Compliance Team.
Coordinate customs clearance activities with brokers, freight forwarders, and government authorities.
Maintain accurate shipping and trade documentation.
Monitor changes in customs duties, trade agreements, and regulatory requirements

Ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law requirements, Saudi Customs regulations, Regulations issued by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), Transportation regulations issued by the Transport General Authority (TGA), Environmental, health, and safety regulations.
